ui.title: Antigravity Actions
ui.bannerIntro: Each action provides 4 options: ⚡ Execute (runs immediately), ⌨️ Command (inserts slash-command), 💬 Prompt (inserts AI prompt), and 📋 Copy (copies both).
ui.btnCommandTitle: Copy slash command to insert into chat (Ctrl+V)
ui.btnPromptTitle: Copy AI prompt to insert into chat (Ctrl+V)
ui.btnCopyTitle: Copy slash command and full prompt to clipboard
ui.readyStatus: Ready to send commands to Antigravity chat.
ui.toastCommandCopied: 📋 Command copied: {cmd}. Press Ctrl+V in chat!
ui.toastPromptCopied: 💬 Prompt copied! Press Ctrl+V in chat to edit or send.
ui.toastBothCopied: 📋 Command and prompt copied to clipboard!
ui.connError: Connection error. Copied command to clipboard (press Ctrl+V).

commit.name: Commit
commit.desc: /commit — Conventional Commit based on git diff analysis
commit.prompt: Commit staged and modified changes with a Conventional Commit message. Inspect git diff and verify that no secrets or temporary files are included.
commit.promptWithInput: Commit staged and modified changes with a Conventional Commit message. Message: "{input}". Inspect git diff and verify that no secrets or temporary files are included.

codereview.name: Code Review
codereview.desc: /code-review — deep review of changes, bugs, and code style
codereview.prompt: Perform a deep Code Review of uncommitted changes and current diff. Check logic correctness, security vulnerabilities, edge cases, performance, and code style.
codereview.promptWithInput: Perform a deep Code Review of {input}. Check logic correctness, security vulnerabilities, edge cases, performance, and code style.

test.name: Run Tests
test.desc: /run-tests — run project test suite and diagnose failures
test.prompt: Detect the project test framework, run the test suite, analyze any failures, explain root causes, and suggest fixes.
test.promptWithInput: Detect the project test framework and run tests for {input}. Analyze any failures, explain root causes, and suggest fixes.

deploy.name: Deploy
deploy.desc: /deploy — build and safe project deployment pipeline
deploy.prompt: Execute safe deployment pipeline: check git branch and clean state, run tests and linters, build artifacts, and deploy.
deploy.promptWithInput: Execute safe deployment pipeline for environment: {input}. Check git branch and clean state, run tests and linters, build artifacts, and deploy.

release.name: Release
release.desc: /release — SemVer calculation, changelog, and git tag
release.placeholder: Bump type (patch, minor, major or version)
release.prompt: Prepare project release: analyze commit history since last tag, calculate SemVer bump, update changelog and manifest versions, and create git tag.
release.promptWithInput: Prepare project release ({input}): analyze commit history since last tag, calculate SemVer bump, update changelog and manifest versions, and create git tag.
